# Whiteboard

Self-hosted workspaces and editable Excalidraw scenes.

## Documentation

- [Dashboard](docs/dashboard.md): workspace navigation, original dashboard theme, scene import limits and behavior.

- [Browser collaboration](docs/browser-collaboration.md): locally verified release-candidate admission, offline recovery, scoped queues, images and local undo.
- [Screen sharing](docs/live-media.md): admitted video-only screen media, union capacity, signaling and cleanup contract.
- [Workspace invitations](docs/collaboration.md): locally verified release-candidate invitation API, roles, registration, credential-attempt 429/Retry-After handling and replacement-scene recovery limits.
- [Diagram catalog](docs/diagram-catalog.md): native presets and supported input schemas.
- [Version history](docs/version-history.md): immutable checkpoint API, authorization, retry semantics and limits.

- [Scene assets](docs/scene-assets.md): locally verified release-candidate scoped upload/view, size/MIME limits, expiry and required headers.

- [Agent keys and MCP](docs/mcp.md): scoped keys, transport configuration, pagination and PAT compatibility.

## Release status

Collaboration v2 is deployed on VM100. Access, invitations, sharing, durable Yjs editing, native image hydration, presence/follow, two-peer voice, MCP and the 50-client acceptance workload pass the local real-stack suite; public deep-link/S3/MCP write/export/share/invite/roles/mobile/keyboard/two-peer browser media/internal denial/log, Docker DNS restart/replay, authenticated TURN allocation and controlled reboot recovery also pass. `/collab/` is the only realtime socket; Socket.IO is retired. Same-host browser media selected host/host candidates; cross-network relay proof is recorded separately in the release checklist.
